prompt: Recast this first-person account as a neutral incident summary: 'I opened the cupboard and the loose shelf tipped forward. Nothing broke, but three folders fell. I moved the remaining folders to the table and left a note so nobody else would use the cupboard.' Aim for about 80 words.
text: A loose shelf in a cupboard tipped forward when the cupboard was opened. No damage or injuries were reported; however, three folders fell from the shelf. The remaining folders were removed and placed on a table to prevent further instability. A note was left on the cupboard advising others not to use it until the shelf can be inspected and secured.
